outputs.text:
⛔ anti-hall · tasklist-guard: stop blocked: 4 file-changing actions this session but NO tasks tracked.
Why: Work this size needs a task list and a progress file.
Do instead: Capture the work as priority-sorted tasks via TaskCreate/TaskUpdate (TaskList first to dedup; link with addBlockedBy/addBlocks), set statuses, and update <CWD>/.anti-hall/progress/<DATE>/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000.md (done/in-progress/next); a new file gets this header on top: <!-- session: 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 | started: <TS> -->. Gitignore it. Append each COMPLETED task to <CWD>/.anti-hall/history/<DATE>/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000.md (append-only ledger, one entry per task: Cause / Fix / Verified; gitignore it too; it usually exists already, so append with the Edit tool or a one-line `>>`, never the Write tool). The progress file can be written freely. No Bash heredoc (git-guard scans its body as shell).
💡 anti-hall · handover: no handover exists yet after significant work.
Do instead: consider /anti-hall:handover before ending.
Override (only if the user explicitly confirmed this exact condition is fine): write {"tasklist-guard:6623c450da2f75b4": <EPOCH>} into <HOME>/.anti-hall/stop-ack/stop-ack-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000.json (merge with existing keys); it then stays advisory for the rest of the session.
